messages:
maya: Quick check — Thursday release train: we need to finalize who owns the 09:30 and 10:45 lanes. 09:30 has the model-serving change (small weights + quant), 10:45 has runtime GC/kv-cache tweak. Who's taking which and can confirm smoke + rollback plan?

alex: I can take 09:30 for model-serving. Planning a canary 5% -> 50% for 15m, then full. Smoke checklist ready.

santiago: I'll take 10:45 for the runtime GC change. I'll run a node-level soak on staging first, then stagger to prod.

jamie: Awesome — @alex @santiago please confirm smoke steps. For model-serving (alex) I need: sample inference test, kv cache warm, latency + p50/p95 dashboards. For runtime (santiago) I need: memory ramp test, connection drain check, and tail latency runbook.

alex: Smoke steps for 09:30: 1) push canary image tag `canary-3449` to cluster 2) run `curl -sS https://smoke.test/api/v1/health?model=quant` against canary 3) run `python infra/bench/latency_check.py --target canary` 4) KV warm: `redis-cli --eval infra/smoke/warm_kv.lua` 5) confirm traces show no spike in token latency. I will post links to results in thread.

santiago: Smoke steps for 10:45: 1) deploy runtime with `GC=aggressive` to a single lane 2) run `loadtest --rps 200 --duration 5m` 3) check `node_free_mem` and `requests_dropped` metrics 4) run connect-drain: `kubectl cordon && kubectl drain --ignore-daemonsets` on one node in canary group.

liam: Rollback plan questions: if model canary looks ok but full rollout causes regressor errors, what's the immediate revert command? Also what's the expected repro window for kv warm side effects?

alex: Revert command: `kubectl set image deployment/model-serving model-serving=registry/redwood:model-v1 --record` then scale back canary: `kubectl set env deploy/model-serving ROLLOUT_MODE=stable`. Expected kv warm side-effects should disappear within 10–20m after revert; we'll also clear the warmed prefixes with `redis-cli DEL prefix:*` if needed.

eva: I'll own monitoring for both lanes. I'll pin a dashboard and alert on: token_latency_p95 > 350ms, inference_errors > 0.5%, and kv_miss_rate increase > 5%. I'll also open a short-lived log stream during the rollout.

jamie: Nice. Can we add a preflight checklist to the deploy ticket? I'll add: review canary metrics, run smoke commands, post results, +2 from owner, backup DB snapshot (if applicable).

alex: +2 from me on the model side for the preflight once smoke passes. I'll attach bench logs.

santiago: +2 from me for runtime after soak. I'll also add a note that GC flags are toggleable via feature flag if we need immediate mitigation.

deploy-bot: Scheduled: 09:30 UTC — `model-serving-canary` by alex; 10:45 UTC — `runtime-gc-lane` by santiago. Reminders set: 15m before each.

maya: Great. Final ask: if either lane needs immediate rollback, the deploy owner calls `@oncall` and triggers the rollback command above. Keep this thread updated with smoke links. I'll mark the release train ticket as green once both preflight results are in. :thumbsup:
